sources.title: AI Security Incident Case: Encrypted Reasoning Blocks of Proprietary ...
sources.snippet: The research reveals a common architectural flaw in the reasoning model APIs of three major AI providers, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google, which allows attackers to extract complete plaintext chains of thought from the encrypted reasoning blocks of their flagship models.

sources.title: DCMFNet: Deep Cross-Modal Fusion Network for Different Modalities with ...
sources.snippet: Referring image segmentation (RIS) is a fundamental cross-modal task that intends to segment a desired object from an image based on a given natural language expression. In this paper, we propose an efficient algorithm called the Deep Cross-Modal Fusion Network (DCMFNet) to address this challenge.

sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Deep Learning Multi-Modal Fusion: Methods ...
sources.snippet: This paper comprehensively reviews existing methods based on multi-modal fusion techniques and completes a detailed and in-depth analysis. According to the data fusion stage, multi-modal fusion has four primary methods: early fusion, deep fusion, late fusion, and hybrid fusion.

sources.title: CMFFN: An efficient cross-modal feature fusion network for semantic ...
sources.snippet: To address the diversity in modal representations and the complexity arising from the addition of modalities, the fusion part of the CMFFN network adopts a cross-modal attention mechanism based on feature-level queries, while employing lightweight methods to effectively reduce training costs.
